morphology.pattern_note: fikir 是借入后独立使用的词根，不拆 fi- 和 -kir。规范词族有 berfikir、memikir、memikirkan；这里 memikirkan 使用 mem-，词首 f 脱落，不能据此断言所有 f 开头借词都同样处理。pikir 是变体，不是正式大马拼写的首选。

senses.zh_definition: 思维；心智；思考与记忆的能力。
senses.ms_definition: ingatan, angan-angan, akal
senses.nuances: 《Kamus Dewan》第四版义项 1 摘录。常保留在 daya fikir、ahli fikir 等组合中；一般说“我的想法”常用 fikiran saya，不能把所有名词 fikiran 任意删成 fikir。
senses.en_definition: The mind; the faculty of thought, imagination, and memory.

senses.zh_definition: 看法；意见；个人的判断或猜想。
senses.ms_definition: anggapan, pendapat, sangka, kira
senses.nuances: 《Kamus Dewan》第四版义项 2 摘录。pada fikir saya 和 fikirku 可引出个人判断，后者较有叙述或文学色彩；现代中性写作也常用 pada pendapat saya。不要与下一义的 Saya fikir... 混淆词性。
senses.en_definition: An opinion, judgment, or supposition.

senses.zh_definition: 想；思考；仔细考虑。
senses.ms_definition: menggunakan akal (utk menyelesaikan sesuatu dsb), mempertimbangkan (dlm ingatan)
senses.nuances: 此马来语释义摘自《Kamus Dewan》第四版词族 berfikir，借以解释目标词的裸词干动词用法，并非伪造一个独立编号原义。Fikir dahulu! 可作祈使；规范叙述通常用 berfikir，及物地考虑某事常用 memikirkan sesuatu。
senses.en_definition: To use the mind to reason, solve a problem, or consider something.

senses.zh_definition: 认为；以为；对某件事持某种判断。
senses.ms_definition: menganggap; menyangka
senses.nuances: 《Kamus Pelajar》第二版 memikir 释义摘录，其例句直接使用 Engkau fikir...；在本词条说明无前缀的实际用法。Saya fikir dia sudah pulang 是“我想他已回去”，不必解释为正进行费力思考。你以为……式的 Awak fikir...? 可能带质问语气。
senses.en_definition: To believe or suppose that something is the case.

dual_scenarios.context: 教育报道 / 思考能力培养
dual_scenarios.ms: Program pendidikan itu bertujuan meningkatkan daya fikir murid melalui perbincangan dan penyelesaian masalah.
dual_scenarios.zh: 该教育项目旨在通过讨论与解决问题来提升学生的思考能力。
dual_scenarios.en: The education programme aims to develop pupils' thinking skills through discussion and problem-solving.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 两位同事推测另一位同事是否已经离开办公室
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Awak nampak Faiz tak? Saya cari kat meja dia tadi, tak ada.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Adakah awak melihat Faiz? Saya mencarinya di mejanya tadi, tetapi dia tiada di situ.
dual_scenarios.zh: 你看见 Faiz 了吗？我刚才去他座位找他，人不在。
spoken_features: Saya fikir 引出个人判断；结合 kot，表示推测，而非确认对方已经回家。
dah 对应 sudah；balik 是日常用语，这里可用 pulang 作规范等值表达。
Awak nampak Faiz tak? 以句末 tak 构成口语是非问句。
Beg dia pun dah tak ada 以包不见了作为推测依据；pun 在这里对应 juga。
patutlah 表示获得解释后的“难怪”。

messages.speaker: Nadia (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Awak nampak Faiz tak? Saya cari kat meja dia tadi, tak ada.
messages.ms_standard: Adakah awak melihat Faiz? Saya mencarinya di mejanya tadi, tetapi dia tiada di situ.
messages.zh: 你看见 Faiz 了吗？我刚才去他座位找他，人不在。
messages.en: Have you seen Faiz? I went to look for him at his desk earlier, but he wasn't there.

messages.speaker: Farhan (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Saya fikir dia dah balik kot. Beg dia pun dah tak ada. Cuba mesej dia dulu.
messages.ms_standard: Saya berpendapat bahawa dia mungkin sudah pulang. Begnya juga sudah tiada. Cuba hantar mesej kepadanya dahulu.
messages.zh: 我想他大概已经回去了吧。他的包也不在了。先给他发个消息看看。
messages.en: I think he's probably gone home. His bag's gone too. Try messaging him first.

messages.speaker: Nadia (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Oh, patutlah. Okey, saya tanya dia sekarang.
messages.ms_standard: Oh, tidak hairanlah. Baiklah, saya akan bertanya kepadanya sekarang.
messages.zh: 哦，难怪。好，我现在问问他。
messages.en: Oh, that explains it. Okay, I'll ask him now.

spoken_shortcuts.note: 聊天省元音写法；正式作文、公函用 fikir 或所需的派生形式。
口语或地区变体，属于替代拼写而非字母缩写；规范大马书写首选 fikir。pk 容易有其他展开，英语 thinking 也不是马来语缩写，均不收作直接对应。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: Saya fikir... 可表明只是个人看法，给讨论留下余地。与不熟悉的人或长辈沟通时，用 Boleh kita fikirkan dahulu? 邀请一起考虑，比单独命令 Fikir! 柔和。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: Fikir dulu! 对朋友可作提醒，对上级或陌生人可能像训斥。Jangan fikir bukan-bukan（别胡思乱想）也可能轻视对方的担忧，宜先了解其处境。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: Saya fikir... 可表明只是个人看法，给讨论留下余地。与不熟悉的人或长辈沟通时，用 Boleh kita fikirkan dahulu? 邀请一起考虑，比单独命令 Fikir! 柔和。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: Fikir dulu! 对朋友可作提醒，对上级或陌生人可能像训斥。Jangan fikir bukan-bukan（别胡思乱想）也可能轻视对方的担忧，宜先了解其处境。

etymology.source_language: Arabic（阿拉伯语），经古典马来语
etymology.root_origin: 阿拉伯语 فِكْر fikr，意为思考、思想、想法；经古典马来语传承为现代 fikir。
etymology.historical_story: 阿拉伯语 fikr 表示思想与思考，借入马来语后以 fikir 的音形流传，并经古典马来语进入现代语言。它可以放在马来世界通过海路与更广阔伊斯兰知识网络交往的背景里理解，但所给词源并未锁定具体港口或借入年份。这个词如今既进入 pemikiran 等讨论思想的词语，也进入最日常的 Saya fikir...；本土词 renung 和 benak 仍有各自用法，不能说被它完全淘汰。
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把阿拉伯语 fikr 记成在 k 与 r 之间加一盏小灯 i，照亮 fikir；再分清 berfikir 是思考、fikiran 是想法、pemikir 是思考者。

morphology.pattern_note: 阿拉伯语整词借入，现代作为基本词；memahami 和 pemahaman 中词首 f 保留，不按 p 的鼻音同化规则删去。

word_family.gloss: 理解过程；所理解的内容

senses.zh_definition: 明白；真正理解某事的意思或情况。
senses.ms_definition: tahu dan mengerti benar akan sesuatu
senses.nuances: tahu 常强调知道事实，faham 强调领会其意思。口语可说 saya faham；正式带宾语时常用 memahami。懂对方的意思不等于同意对方。
senses.en_definition: To understand clearly the meaning or nature of something.

senses.zh_definition: 理解；头脑中对事物的认识或领会。
senses.ms_definition: = fahaman pengetahuan dlm fikiran mengenai sesuatu, pengertian
senses.nuances: 作为现代抽象名词时，kefahaman 或 pemahaman 往往更明确；单独 faham 的名词义也见于古典或较凝练表达。
senses.en_definition: Understanding; a mental grasp or interpretation of something.

senses.zh_definition: 看法；个人持有的观点或判断。
senses.ms_definition: fikiran atau anggapan dsb yg menjadi pegangan seseorang, pendapat
senses.nuances: berbeza faham 表看法不同，不必意味着没有听懂；现代日常表达也常用 pendapat。
senses.en_definition: An opinion or view held by someone.

senses.zh_definition: 思想；主义；个人或社会奉行的信念体系。
senses.ms_definition: kepercayaan (pegangan) individu atau masyarakat tentang sesuatu
senses.nuances: 多见于政治、哲学和思想论述；现代也常用派生词 fahaman。此处不是表示当下“听懂了”的动词。
senses.en_definition: An ideology or system of beliefs held by an individual or society.

dual_scenarios.context: 新闻 / 政策说明会
dual_scenarios.ms: Kementerian akan memperluas sesi penerangan bagi memastikan orang ramai faham akan tujuan dasar baharu itu.
dual_scenarios.zh: 该部将扩大说明会的覆盖范围，确保公众理解这项新政策的目的。
dual_scenarios.en: The ministry will expand its briefing sessions to ensure that the public understands the purpose of the new policy.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 两位朋友确认活动报名费是否包含午餐
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Yuran tu dah termasuk makan tengah hari. Masa sampai nanti, tunjuk je kod dalam e-mel.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Yuran itu sudah merangkumi makan tengah hari. Apabila kamu tiba nanti, kamu hanya perlu menunjukkan kod dalam e-mel.
dual_scenarios.zh: 那笔费用已经包含午餐。到的时候出示邮件里的代码就行了。
spoken_features: faham 在这里表示经过解释后真正明白情况；dah faham 对应 sudah faham。
tu、dah、tak 分别对应 itu、sudah、tidak；tunjuk je 表示“只需出示”。
ingat 在这里表示“以为”，标准句使用 menyangka；kena 表示“需要、必须”，并非“被”。
rupanya 引出与原先想法不同的实际情况；tak perlu pun 中的 pun 强调原来无需另外付费。

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Yuran tu dah termasuk makan tengah hari. Masa sampai nanti, tunjuk je kod dalam e-mel.
messages.ms_standard: Yuran itu sudah merangkumi makan tengah hari. Apabila kamu tiba nanti, kamu hanya perlu menunjukkan kod dalam e-mel.
messages.zh: 那笔费用已经包含午餐。到的时候出示邮件里的代码就行了。
messages.en: The fee includes lunch. Just show the code in your email when you get there.

messages.speaker: Hafiz (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Oh, sekarang aku dah faham. Tadi ingat kena bayar makan lagi, rupanya tak perlu pun.
messages.ms_standard: Oh, sekarang saya sudah faham. Tadi saya menyangka bahawa saya perlu membayar lagi untuk makan tengah hari, tetapi rupa-rupanya tidak perlu.
messages.zh: 哦，现在我懂了。刚才还以为午餐要另外付钱，原来根本不用。
messages.en: Oh, I get it now. I thought we had to pay extra for lunch, but it turns out we don't.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 单独追问 Faham? 可能像命令或质问，尤其面对成人同事；可改说 Adakah penerangan saya jelas?，把焦点放在自己的说明是否清楚。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: Saya faham 可表示已理解或体谅，不自动表示赞同。在多语言沟通中允许对方要求重复，不用 Tak faham bahasa? 这类容易被听成责骂的说法。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 单独追问 Faham? 可能像命令或质问，尤其面对成人同事；可改说 Adakah penerangan saya jelas?，把焦点放在自己的说明是否清楚。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: Saya faham 可表示已理解或体谅，不自动表示赞同。在多语言沟通中允许对方要求重复，不用 Tak faham bahasa? 这类容易被听成责骂的说法。

etymology.root_origin: 借自阿拉伯语 فَهْم（fahm，理解），与动词 فَهِمَ（fahima，理解）相关。
etymology.historical_story: 阿拉伯语 fahm 表示理解，借入马来语后形成 faham，把“领会意义”保留为核心。马来世界的阿拉伯语宗教与知识交流为这类借词提供了文化背景；今天课堂里的 saya faham、朋友间的相互体谅和思想讨论中的 fahaman，让同一词族进入了不同的生活领域，而具体首借年代仍不能由现有材料确定。
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把学习分成两步：tahu 是知道有这件事，faham 是心里真正弄明白；有了 faham，再加 memahami 表理解某个对象。

morphology.formula: ∅ + font → font（英语整词；规范马来语对应 fon）
morphology.pattern_note: 英语词在马来语数码交流中混用，作为整体识别，不按马来语前后缀拆分。fon 是马来语对应形式，不是聊天缩写；IPA 采用英语英式参考音，实际混语读法会有差异。原包无官方分音或爪夷文，不据 fon 反推 font 的官方写法。

senses.zh_definition: 字体；电脑或排版系统中所用的一套字形。此处保留英语拼写。
senses.ms_definition: Huraian editorial, bukan petikan Kamus Dewan bagi kata font: set rupa bentuk aksara yang digunakan dalam paparan atau cetakan; padanan bahasa Melayu ialah fon.
senses.nuances: font 在设计、排版和聊天中常作为英语词混入马来语；正式马来语通常写 fon。jenis font、saiz font 是混语搭配，对应规范的 jenis fon、saiz fon。日常常把 font 与 typeface 一并说成‘字体’，专业排版可进一步区分具体字体资源与字型设计。

collocations.zh: 字体类型（混语；规范写 jenis fon）
字号（混语；规范写 saiz fon）

senses.en_definition: A set of characters in a particular design, used in digital displays or printing.

dual_scenarios.context: 资讯报道 / 解释数码排版术语
dual_scenarios.ms: Istilah bahasa Inggeris "font" merujuk kepada fon yang digunakan untuk memaparkan teks pada skrin atau dalam bahan bercetak.
dual_scenarios.zh: 英语术语“font”指用于屏幕文字显示或印刷材料的字体。
dual_scenarios.en: The English term "font" refers to the font used to display text on a screen or in printed material.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 工作群里检查准备发布的海报
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Font ni kecik sangat. Boleh besarkan sikit tak? Kat telefon susah nak baca.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Saiz fon ini terlalu kecil. Bolehkah saiznya dibesarkan sedikit? Teksnya sukar dibaca pada telefon.
dual_scenarios.zh: 这字号太小了。能放大一点吗？在手机上很难看清。
spoken_features: font 保留英语拼写，规范马来语对应 fon；这里的 font kecik 指字号小。
kecik 是 kecil 的口语形式，ni 对应 ini，sikit 对应 sedikit。
boleh … tak 是常见口语问句结构，规范表达可用 bolehkah。
tengok balik 在此指重新查看、复核；句末 ya 让请求更柔和。

messages.speaker: Farhan (同事，负责检查海报的人)
messages.ms_spoken: Font ni kecik sangat. Boleh besarkan sikit tak? Kat telefon susah nak baca.
messages.ms_standard: Saiz fon ini terlalu kecil. Bolehkah saiznya dibesarkan sedikit? Teksnya sukar dibaca pada telefon.
messages.zh: 这字号太小了。能放大一点吗？在手机上很难看清。
messages.en: This font's way too small. Can you make it a bit bigger? It's hard to read on a phone.

messages.speaker: Siti (同事，负责设计海报的人)
messages.ms_spoken: Boleh, aku besarkan tajuk dengan tarikh dulu. Nanti kau tengok balik, ya.
messages.ms_standard: Boleh, saya akan membesarkan saiz fon untuk tajuk dan tarikh dahulu. Selepas itu, sila semak semula.
messages.zh: 可以，我先把标题和日期的字号放大。等下你再检查一下啊。
messages.en: Sure, I'll make the title and date bigger first. Have another look after that, okay?

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 设计师或熟悉电脑的同事之间使用 font 通常容易理解；面向公众的马来语说明可用 fon，并在首次出现时附上英语界面名称。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 讨论修改时明确是字号、字型还是粗细，避免只说 font tak cantik。为不同年龄和语言背景的读者选择清楚易读的文字，并用具体请求表达意见。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 设计师或熟悉电脑的同事之间使用 font 通常容易理解；面向公众的马来语说明可用 fon，并在首次出现时附上英语界面名称。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 讨论修改时明确是字号、字型还是粗细，避免只说 font tak cantik。为不同年龄和语言背景的读者选择清楚易读的文字，并用具体请求表达意见。

etymology.source_language: 英语；排印义更早与法语 fonte、fondre 有关
etymology.root_origin: 英语 font 的排印义联系法语 fonte‘铸造’与 fondre‘熔化、铸造’；参见 American Printing History Association：https://printinghistory.org/font-or-fount/ 。
etymology.historical_story: 在金属活字排印的年代，一套字需要通过铸造制作，英语 font 的排印义因此留下了法语‘铸造’的历史痕迹。印刷桌上的金属字后来变成屏幕里的字体资源，同一个词也随英语软件术语出现在马来语的数码交流中。现代规范马来语使用 fon，聊天里则常直接保留屏幕上看到的 font。
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把一套金属字‘铸’出来，再放进电脑的字体菜单：font 管字形，saiz font 管字有多大。

morphology.pattern_note: 词根 fikir 不变；-kan 在这里把思考指向对象，不必机械译成使。常见于祈使句、第一或第二人称被动结构及省略 meN- 的口语；完整主动形式 memikirkan 中，meN- 在 f 前实现为 mem-，f 保留。PRPM 未收独立词头，官方音节与 Jawi 保留 null。 核心词根（Kata Dasar）「fikir」官方爪夷文为「فيکير」，派生附加 -kan。

senses.zh_definition: 考虑；思量；把某事放在脑中权衡。
senses.ms_definition: menggunakan akal (utk menyelesaikan sesuatu), merenungkan, mempertimbangkan (dlm fikiran). (Kamus Dewan Edisi Keempat, fikir → memikirkan, makna 1)
senses.nuances: 此处引用词根条目下 memikirkan 的释义，非独立 fikirkan 词条。Fikirkan dahulu 是先想一想的祈使句；Perkara itu perlu saya fikirkan 是标准第一人称被动结构，不能把所有无 meN- 的形式都判为口语。
senses.en_definition: To think about something carefully in order to understand it, solve it, or make a decision.

senses.zh_definition: 想起；挂念；想着某人的处境或将来。
senses.ms_definition: mengenangkan. (Kamus Dewan Edisi Keempat, fikir → memikirkan, makna 2)
senses.nuances: 侧重心里惦记的内容，不一定是在解决问题。fikirkan masa depan 可依语境表示想到未来或认真规划未来。官方释义援引 memikirkan。
senses.en_definition: To think of or be concerned about someone or something.

senses.zh_definition: 顾及；在意；把某人的利益或感受放在心上。
senses.ms_definition: mengendahkan, mempedulikan, memandang penting. (Kamus Dewan Edisi Keempat, fikir → memikirkan, makna 3)
senses.nuances: 不只是产生一个念头，而是要求行动时也顾及有关的人或事。Jangan fikirkan diri sendiri sahaja 是别只顾自己；官方释义援引 memikirkan。
senses.en_definition: To take someone's interests or feelings into account; to regard something as important.

dual_scenarios.context: 报章专访／社区建设方案
dual_scenarios.ms: Cadangan pembinaan dewan itu akan saya fikirkan dengan teliti sebelum keputusan dibuat.
dual_scenarios.zh: 在作出决定之前，我会仔细考虑兴建该礼堂的建议。
dual_scenarios.en: I will carefully consider the proposal to build the hall before a decision is made.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 朋友邀请周末去露营，对方需要考虑费用
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Hujung minggu ni nak ikut kitorang camping tak? Dalam RM150 sorang.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Adakah awak hendak menyertai kami untuk berkhemah pada hujung minggu ini? Kosnya kira-kira RM150 seorang.
dual_scenarios.zh: 这周末要跟我们去露营吗？大约每人150令吉。
spoken_features: bagi aku fikirkan dulu 是让我先考虑一下的口语表达；fikirkan 的宾语由上一轮的露营邀约补足。
kitorang 对应不包含听话者的 kami；sorang 在费用语境中表示每人，对应 seorang。
camping、confirm 是英语夹用；dulu、bagitahu、je 分别对应 dahulu、beritahu、sahaja。

messages.speaker: Lina (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Hujung minggu ni nak ikut kitorang camping tak? Dalam RM150 sorang.
messages.ms_standard: Adakah awak hendak menyertai kami untuk berkhemah pada hujung minggu ini? Kosnya kira-kira RM150 seorang.
messages.zh: 这周末要跟我们去露营吗？大约每人150令吉。
messages.en: Want to come camping with us this weekend? It'll be about RM150 each.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Bagi aku fikirkan dulu, boleh? Bajet bulan ni ketat sikit. Esok aku bagitahu.
messages.ms_standard: Bolehkah awak memberi saya masa untuk memikirkan perkara itu dahulu? Peruntukan perbelanjaan saya agak terhad pada bulan ini. Saya akan memberikan jawapan esok.
messages.zh: 让我先考虑一下，可以吗？这个月手头有点紧。我明天给你答复。
messages.en: Can I think about it first? Money's a bit tight this month. I'll let you know tomorrow.

messages.speaker: Lina (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Boleh je. Esok malam baru kitorang confirm jumlah orang.
messages.ms_standard: Boleh sahaja. Kami hanya akan mengesahkan jumlah peserta pada malam esok.
messages.zh: 当然可以。我们明晚才确定参加人数。
messages.en: Sure, no problem. We're only confirming the numbers tomorrow night.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: Biar saya fikirkan dahulu 可礼貌地争取考虑时间；向他人提出建议时用 cuba fikirkan，比直接下令更温和。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 让我考虑一下可能是真正需要时间，也可能是在委婉推迟答复，不宜自动当成同意。要求作决定时说明截止时间，避免持续催问或指责对方不会思考。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: Biar saya fikirkan dahulu 可礼貌地争取考虑时间；向他人提出建议时用 cuba fikirkan，比直接下令更温和。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 让我考虑一下可能是真正需要时间，也可能是在委婉推迟答复，不宜自动当成同意。要求作决定时说明截止时间，避免持续催问或指责对方不会思考。

etymology.root_origin: fikir 源自阿拉伯语 فِكْر (fikr，思考、思想)，经古典马来语沿用；fikirkan 是马来语内部的后缀派生。
etymology.historical_story: 阿拉伯语 fikr 表示思考与思想，进入马来语后形成适合本地发音的 fikir；这种借词可放在群岛港口与宗教学术社群交流的背景下理解，但没有资料足以指定它第一次传入的航程。马来语再给它接上 -kan，把思考落到具体对象上，于是今天既能郑重地考虑公共方案，也能在聊天中说先让我想想。
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fikir 想成脑中的灯，-kan 把灯照向一个对象：fikirkan masalah ini，想想这个问题。

morphology.pattern_note: -an 构成名词，表示思考的能力、内容或结果；词根 fikir 的 r 保留，不写成 fikiran 的伪词根 fiki。

word_family.gloss: 思维；思想体系；思考过程

senses.zh_definition: 思考能力；头脑；心智；记忆。
senses.ms_definition: daya berfikir, akal, ingatan. (Kamus Dewan Edisi Keempat)
senses.nuances: 指人的心智状态或思考能力。hilang fikiran 可形容慌得不知所措，具体含义须看语境；不宜用 sakit fikiran 嘲讽有心理健康困扰的人。
senses.en_definition: The mind; the ability to think, reason, and remember.

senses.zh_definition: 想法；意见；思考所得的判断或主意。
senses.ms_definition: hasil pemikiran, pendapat, pertimbangan akal, upaya, muslihat. (Kamus Dewan Edisi Keempat)
senses.nuances: 可指建设性的意见，也可依语境指应对困境的计策；muslihat 是原释义涵盖的可能意义，不表示 fikiran 一定带欺骗色彩。buah fikiran 指想法或见解，bertukar fikiran 指交换意见。
senses.en_definition: An idea, opinion, judgment, or plan formed through thought.

senses.zh_definition: 意向；打算；心愿或设想。
senses.ms_definition: niat, cita-cita, angan-angan. (Kamus Dewan Edisi Keempat)
senses.nuances: 表示心里打算做什么，多由 hendak 或 untuk 引出内容；日常表达明确计划时 niat、hasrat 或 rancangan 往往更直接。下列搭配是自然的语境组合，不是固定成语。

collocations.en: the thought of getting a job

collocations.zh: 想要停止或辞职的念头
collocations.en: the thought of stopping or quitting

senses.en_definition: An intention, aspiration, or imagined possibility.

senses.zh_definition: 关注；注意力；对某事的兴趣。
senses.ms_definition: perhatian, minat. (Kamus Dewan Edisi Keempat)
senses.nuances: 强调把心思放在某件事上。menaruh fikiran 是词典收录的表达，现代日常谈话常说 memberi perhatian；menumpukan fikiran 也涉及集中精神。

collocations.en: give one's attention to one's studies

senses.en_definition: Attention or interest directed towards something.

dual_scenarios.context: 教育报道／教学研讨会
dual_scenarios.ms: Bengkel itu memberi peluang kepada para guru untuk bertukar fikiran tentang kaedah pengajaran yang lebih berkesan.
dual_scenarios.zh: 这场工作坊让教师们有机会就更有效的教学方法交换意见。
dual_scenarios.en: The workshop gives teachers an opportunity to exchange ideas about more effective teaching methods.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 好友更改周末出游计划
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Esok aku ambil kau pukul lapan eh? Kita sarapan dulu sebelum gerak.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Esok saya akan menjemput awak pada pukul lapan, boleh? Kita bersarapan dahulu sebelum bertolak.
dual_scenarios.zh: 明天我八点去接你，好吗？我们先吃早餐再出发。
spoken_features: ubah fikiran 是改变主意的固定搭配；口语 ubah 省略 mengubah 的前缀。
eh 在第一轮用于征求确认；ambil 在此指接人，gerak 指动身。
sorry 和 plan 是熟人聊天中的英语语码转换；gi 对应 pergi。
je 对应 sahaja；最后的 lah 让建议带有熟人之间较缓和的语气。

messages.speaker: Siti (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Esok aku ambil kau pukul lapan eh? Kita sarapan dulu sebelum gerak.
messages.ms_standard: Esok saya akan menjemput awak pada pukul lapan, boleh? Kita bersarapan dahulu sebelum bertolak.
messages.zh: 明天我八点去接你，好吗？我们先吃早餐再出发。
messages.en: I'll pick you up at eight tomorrow, yeah? We'll have breakfast before we head off.

messages.speaker: Lina (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Sorry, aku dah ubah fikiran. Minggu ni penat sangat, nak duduk rumah je. Kau gi dengan Mira dulu lah.
messages.ms_standard: Maaf, saya sudah mengubah fikiran. Saya sangat penat pada minggu ini dan hanya mahu berehat di rumah. Pergilah bersama Mira dahulu.
messages.zh: 不好意思，我改主意了。这星期太累了，只想待在家。你先跟米拉去吧。
messages.en: Sorry, I've changed my mind. It's been such a tiring week, I just want to stay home. You go with Mira this time.

messages.speaker: Siti (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Okey, rehat dulu. Lain kali kita plan lagi.
messages.ms_standard: Baiklah, berehatlah dahulu. Kita boleh merancang untuk keluar bersama pada masa yang lain.
messages.zh: 好，你先休息。下次我们再约。
messages.en: Okay, get some rest. We'll plan something another time.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 邀请对方表达看法可说 Apakah pandangan anda? 或 Mari kita bertukar fikiran；对长者、主管用 saya 自称较稳妥。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 批评观点应针对内容，避免说对方没有头脑或有病。fikiran terbuka 表示思想开放；不要把文化、宗教或族群差异简单评为心智高低。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 邀请对方表达看法可说 Apakah pandangan anda? 或 Mari kita bertukar fikiran；对长者、主管用 saya 自称较稳妥。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 批评观点应针对内容，避免说对方没有头脑或有病。fikiran terbuka 表示思想开放；不要把文化、宗教或族群差异简单评为心智高低。

etymology.source_language: 阿拉伯语，经马来语词根 fikir 派生
etymology.root_origin: fikir 源于阿拉伯语 فِكْر（fikr，思考、思想）；fikiran 是马来语 fikir + -an，并非直接借入的阿拉伯语词形。
etymology.historical_story: 阿拉伯语 fikr 进入马来语后成为 fikir，属于马来世界与阿拉伯语知识传统接触所形成的词汇。马来语再用自己的后缀 -an 把它变成 fikiran，让这个词既能指头脑里的想法，也能指思考能力；今天它从课堂讨论一路走进朋友间的聊天。
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fikir 想成脑子正在转动，添上 -an 后，fikiran 就是脑子产出的想法或承载想法的心智。

morphology.pattern_note: 英语借词，现代马来语中作为完整词根使用。memfilemkan 保留借词开头的 f；不要套用 p 开头词根的脱落规则。

word_family.gloss: 电影事业；电影相关事务

senses.zh_definition: 胶片；装入相机以记录影像的感光薄片。
senses.ms_definition: benda tipis drpd seluloid yg dimasukkan ke dlm kamera utk membuat gambar (negatif)
senses.nuances: Kamus Dewan 第1义，指实体摄影材料。今天使用数码相机时不能把记忆卡称为 filem；filem negatif 强调底片，filem kamera 指相机胶卷。
senses.en_definition: A thin strip or sheet of light-sensitive material used in a camera to record images.

senses.zh_definition: 电影；由连续活动影像组成的影视作品。
senses.ms_definition: gambar bergerak yg ditayangkan pd layar, biasanya di pawagam, wayang gambar
senses.nuances: Kamus Dewan 第2义，是日常最常见的用法。作品即使在手机或串流平台观看也可叫 filem；pawagam 是电影院这一场所，不能与作品名词互换。
senses.en_definition: A work consisting of moving images, usually shown on a cinema screen.

dual_scenarios.context: 新闻报章／文化活动报道
dual_scenarios.ms: Festival itu akan menayangkan beberapa buah filem dokumentari yang mengetengahkan warisan budaya masyarakat tempatan.
dual_scenarios.zh: 该影展将放映多部呈现本地社会文化遗产的纪录片。
dual_scenarios.en: The festival will screen several documentary films highlighting the cultural heritage of local communities.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 两个朋友商量晚上看电影
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Jom tengok filem ni malam nanti. Kau nak ikut tak?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Mari kita menonton filem ini pada malam nanti. Adakah kamu mahu ikut bersama?
dual_scenarios.zh: 今晚一起看这部电影吧。你要一起去吗？
spoken_features: filem 在此指电影；tengok filem 是日常口语搭配，标准语可用 menonton filem。
jom 表示邀约，对应 mari；ni 对应 ini；nak 对应 mahu。
nak 单独作答，承接上一轮的邀约；标准语补全为 Saya mahu ikut。
yang pukul enam 依语境省略‘六点的场次’；je 对应 sahaja，lah 在此缓和建议语气。

messages.speaker: Haziq (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Jom tengok filem ni malam nanti. Kau nak ikut tak?
messages.ms_standard: Mari kita menonton filem ini pada malam nanti. Adakah kamu mahu ikut bersama?
messages.zh: 今晚一起看这部电影吧。你要一起去吗？
messages.en: Let's go watch this film tonight. Wanna come?

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Nak! Tapi jangan yang pukul enam, aku habis kerja lambat sikit.
messages.ms_standard: Saya mahu ikut! Tetapi jangan pilih tayangan pada pukul enam kerana saya selesai bekerja agak lewat.
messages.zh: 要！不过别选六点那场，我下班会晚一点。
messages.en: Yeah! But not the six o'clock showing. I'll be finishing work a bit late.

messages.speaker: Haziq (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Okey, aku beli tiket yang pukul sembilan je. Kita makan dulu lah.
messages.ms_standard: Baiklah, saya akan membeli tiket untuk tayangan pada pukul sembilan sahaja. Kita makan dahulu.
messages.zh: 好，那我就买九点那场的票。我们先吃饭吧。
messages.en: Okay, I'll get tickets for the nine o'clock showing then. Let's grab dinner first.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: filem 是通用中性词，课堂、影评和朋友邀约都适用；与陌生人讨论时可用 saya 和对方的称谓。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 邀请同事或跨族群朋友观影时先询问对方偏好的类型；影评可先提醒是否涉及剧情透露。不要把 filem Melayu 一律理解为所有马来西亚电影，filem Malaysia 的范围更广。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: filem 是通用中性词，课堂、影评和朋友邀约都适用；与陌生人讨论时可用 saya 和对方的称谓。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 邀请同事或跨族群朋友观影时先询问对方偏好的类型；影评可先提醒是否涉及剧情透露。不要把 filem Melayu 一律理解为所有马来西亚电影，filem Malaysia 的范围更广。

etymology.source_language: 英语；现行拼写涉及马来语与印尼语的拼写协调
etymology.root_origin: 英语 film；资料包记录旧拼写 filam，以及采用 filem 的拼写协调背景。
etymology.historical_story: 英语 film 被借入马来语后，词尾辅音之间出现了适合马来语发音的元音，形成今天读作两个音节的 filem，资料包也记录过 filam 这一旧拼写。这个词把相机中的薄薄胶片与银幕上的活动故事连在一起，如今即使电影使用数码技术制作，作品仍然叫 filem。
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把英语 film 中的 l 和 m 之间轻轻垫入一个 /ə/：film → fi-lem；同一词连接‘胶片’与‘电影’。

morphology.formula: ∅ + frank → frank（英语整词；坦率的／为邮件盖邮资戳）
morphology.pattern_note: 所给 PRPM 命中来自 Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan，是英语源词的英马对译，不能据此认定为标准马来语词头。作为英语整词处理；IPA 为编辑补充的英语宽式标音，音节和 Jawi 无官方数据则留空。

senses.zh_definition: ［英语］坦率的；直言不讳的。
senses.ms_definition: terus-terang; (ber)terus-terang
senses.nuances: 此为 Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan 的马来语对译，不是 Kamus Dewan 的马来语词头定义。马来语正式行文一般用 terus terang；frank 可在英语引语或语码转换中出现。这里的固定搭配保留英语形式，避免生造马来语搭配。来源：[PRPM 英马词典](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=frank)。

collocations.zh: ［英语搭配］坦率的意见；马来语 pendapat yang terus terang
［英语搭配］坦白说；马来语 secara terus terang

senses.en_definition: Open and honest in expressing opinions.

senses.zh_definition: ［英语］不掩饰内心想法或感情的；表露无遗的。
senses.ms_definition: tdk menyembunyikan perasaan
senses.nuances: 取自同一英马词典的第二形容词义；描述目光或情感表露，不一定涉及当面直说。英语搭配在此与马来语解释对应，不能当作正式马来语中可任意照搬的形容词结构。

collocations.zh: ［英语搭配］不掩饰心情的目光；马来语 pandangan yang tidak menyembunyikan perasaan
［英语搭配］毫不掩饰的钦佩；马来语 kekaguman yang tidak disembunyikan

senses.en_definition: Openly showing thoughts or feelings without concealment.

senses.zh_definition: ［英语，邮政用语］给邮件盖邮资戳或邮资已付标记。
senses.ms_definition: memfrangki; (pop.) mengecap
senses.nuances: 取自同一英马词典的及物动词条，是与‘坦率’不同的邮政用法；马来语对译用 memfrangki。不能把英语 frank 当作马来语中一般的‘盖章’，也不能因此认定 memfrangki 是对 frank 直接加词缀而成的本词派生。

collocations.zh: ［英语搭配］给信件盖邮资戳；马来语 memfrangki surat
［英语搭配］给信封盖邮资戳；马来语 memfrangki sampul surat

senses.en_definition: To stamp mail with a mark indicating that postage has been paid.

dual_scenarios.context: 新闻报道 / 转述发言中的英语形容词
dual_scenarios.ms: Jurucakap itu menyifatkan perbincangan tersebut sebagai 'frank', yakni terus terang, dan menegaskan bahawa semua pandangan telah diambil kira.
dual_scenarios.zh: 发言人以英语 frank，也就是‘坦率’，形容该讨论，并强调各方意见都已纳入考量。
dual_scenarios.en: The spokesperson described the discussion as 'frank', meaning candid, and stressed that all views had been taken into account.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 熟悉的同事坦率讨论活动场地预算
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: To be frank, aku rasa tempat ni mahal sangat. Kalau sewa sini, bajet makan memang tak cukup.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Secara terus terang, saya berpendapat bahawa tempat ini terlalu mahal. Jika kita menyewanya, peruntukan untuk makanan pasti tidak mencukupi.
dual_scenarios.zh: 坦白说，我觉得这个地方太贵了。要是租这里，吃饭的预算肯定不够。
spoken_features: To be frank 是英语语码转换，整段对应 secara terus terang；frank 在这里是英语形容词。
aku 用于彼此熟悉且接受这种称呼的同事之间；正式工作联系应采用适合关系的称呼。
bajet makan 对应 peruntukan untuk makanan；benda sama 对应 perkara yang sama。
nak ... ke 用于提出建议；jom 在这里接受共同寻找其他场地的提议。
harga dewan 在租场地的上下文中指租金，标准语明确为 kadar sewa dewan。

messages.speaker: Amir (熟悉的同事)
messages.ms_spoken: To be frank, aku rasa tempat ni mahal sangat. Kalau sewa sini, bajet makan memang tak cukup.
messages.ms_standard: Secara terus terang, saya berpendapat bahawa tempat ini terlalu mahal. Jika kita menyewanya, peruntukan untuk makanan pasti tidak mencukupi.
messages.zh: 坦白说，我觉得这个地方太贵了。要是租这里，吃饭的预算肯定不够。

etymology.root_origin: 本批直接来源为英马词典中的英语 frank；更早欧洲语言词源及形容词与邮政动词的历史关系未据本包核实。
etymology.historical_story: frank 在这份材料中是英马词典用来帮助读者理解英语的源词，其马来语对译分别落到‘坦率’和邮政盖戳等意义上。把它放进现代大马聊天场景，To be frank 可以作为英语片段嵌入马来语句子，而正式表达仍可换回 terus terang。这样的双语使用不能单独证明它已经成为标准马来语借词，也不能确定它最初何时进入当地口语。
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 聊天看到 To be frank，先想‘坦白说’；在邮政操作中看到 frank，再想‘盖邮资戳’。人名 Frank 另作姓名辨认。

etymology.historical_story: Fuck has Germanic connections, although its exact route into English remains uncertain. Related forms in other Germanic languages help explain why dictionaries connect it with older words involving striking or sexual activity. Modern conversational uses extend beyond sex into anger, emphasis and indifference. These different functions must be interpreted in context rather than translated literally. Source: [Oxford Learner's Dictionaries](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/fuck_1).

etymology.historical_story: English fucking combines fuck with -ing. Besides its literal sexual use, it functions as an emphatic adjective or adverb, where emotional force replaces literal sexual reference. In a Malay conversation, this English item can be inserted through code-switching. Its grammatical usefulness does not remove the strongly offensive register attached to it. [Source for emphatic uses: Cambridge Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/fucking).

etymology.historical_story: English flash developed from Middle English forms associated with splashing or sudden movement, later acquiring meanings connected with sudden light. Its photographic sense extends that image to equipment producing a momentary burst of illumination. This explains the connection between a visible flash and a camera flash without establishing flash as an official Malay headword.

etymology.root_origin: Federal Bureau of Investigation 的三个词首字母 F、B、I
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把三个字母对上三个名称部分：F＝Federal（联邦），B＝Bureau（局），I＝Investigation（调查）；合起来就是“联邦调查局”。
etymology.historical_story: 这个机构的历史可追溯到1908年成立的一支美国司法部调查队伍，1935年采用 Federal Bureau of Investigation 这一名称。FBI 随之成为该名称的首字母缩写，马来语使用时保留其英语字母形式和专名身份。[FBI 官方历史](https://www.fbi.gov/history/timeline)

word_family.gloss: 精妙的表达；令人愉悦的事物

senses.zh_definition: 深切的幸福、喜悦或美满状态。
senses.en_definition: A state of great happiness or bliss.
senses.ms_definition: Keadaan berasa sangat bahagia atau menikmati kehidupan yang sejahtera dan menggembirakan.
senses.nuances: 英语文学或正式用语，通常不可数。日常马来语通常用 kebahagiaan；不能把 felicity 当成普通马来语名词直接替换使用。

collocations.zh: 家庭或婚姻生活的幸福

senses.zh_definition: 表达、选词或风格恰到好处且令人欣赏的特质。
senses.en_definition: Pleasing aptness, especially in wording or expression.
senses.ms_definition: Sifat ungkapan atau pemilihan kata yang tepat, sesuai dengan maksud dan sedap dibaca atau didengar.
senses.nuances: 通常不可数，常见于英语文学评论。此义强调表达既贴切又精妙，不能一律译作 kebahagiaan。

senses.zh_definition: 具体的一处精妙措辞、贴切表达或成功的艺术处理。
senses.en_definition: An especially apt expression or successful artistic detail.
senses.ms_definition: Ungkapan atau unsur tertentu dalam penulisan, pertuturan atau karya seni yang sangat tepat dan berkesan.
senses.nuances: 可数，通常以英语复数 felicities 出现。指可逐一指出的精彩之处，与上一义的整体表达品质有别。

etymology.historical_story: English acquired felicity in the late Middle English period through Old French felicite, ultimately from Latin felicitas, associated with felix, meaning happy. Its modern meanings connect happiness with the pleasing effect of something perfectly expressed. This is an English borrowing history; its appearance in an English–Malay dictionary does not establish adoption into Malay.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把英语读音 fə-LIS-ə-ti 与两个画面绑定：生活幸福美满；一句话说得恰到好处。记住“幸福感”和“表达贴切”两条意义线。

etymology.historical_story: Frankie belongs to the English tradition of familiar personal names and is recorded as a diminutive of Frank or Frances. Its use spans masculine and feminine naming. Malaysian literary reporting also records the writer Frankie Latit, illustrating the name in local public life without making it a Malay common noun. Sources: [Behind the Name](https://www.behindthename.com/name/frankie), [Dewan Sastera](https://dewansastera.jendeladbp.my/2022/10/26/6439/).

etymology.historical_story: Fred is recorded as a short form of Frederick and other names. Such shortened names can function as familiar forms, while their longer counterparts preserve different naming histories. A token alone therefore cannot identify its bearer’s full name, and the spelling Fred should not be assigned one universal literal meaning. [Behind the Name: Fred](https://www.behindthename.com/name/fred)

etymology.historical_story: English fox descends from Old English fox and belongs to an old Germanic word family. Its figurative association with cunning is also longstanding. etymology.historical_story: English force was borrowed from French force, ultimately connected with Latin fortis, meaning strong. Its meanings extend from strength to compulsion, organized bodies and legal effect. Malay expresses these branches with different words, including daya, kekerasan, pasukan and kuat kuasa; the English spelling alone does not identify the intended meaning. See [Oxford English Dictionary](https://doi.org/10.1093/OED/7007607263).

etymology.historical_story: Father comes from Old English fæder and belongs to an inherited Germanic kinship vocabulary. It is related to German Vater and, more distantly, Latin pater. English later extended the family relationship to founders and religious titles. In Malaysian writing, its presence may reflect English quotation, bilingual communication, or a church form of address. [Etymological account](https://www.etymonline.com/word/father).

senses.zh_definition: 英语词：鱼，通常指用鳃呼吸、以鳍运动的水生脊椎动物。
senses.en_definition: An aquatic vertebrate typically having gills and fins.
senses.ms_definition: Kata bahasa Inggeris yang bermaksud ikan, iaitu haiwan vertebrata akuatik yang lazimnya bernafas melalui insang dan mempunyai sirip.
senses.nuances: 这是英语词义的马来语释义，不是 DBP 对马来语词头 fish 的官方定义。标准马来语使用 ikan。以下 ms 字段采用标准马来语对应搭配；en 字段展示英语 fish 的搭配。[马来西亚渔业局双语门户](https://www.dof.gov.my/)使用 Ikan 与 Fish 对应；[Oxford English Dictionary](https://doi.org/10.1093/OED/7754126200)记录英语词 fish。

senses.zh_definition: 英语词：供食用的鱼或鱼肉。
senses.en_definition: Fish or its flesh used as food.
senses.ms_definition: Ikan atau isi ikan yang dijadikan makanan; makna bagi kata bahasa Inggeris fish dalam konteks makanan.
senses.nuances: 菜单或英语夹杂口语中的 fish 可指鱼类食材或菜肴。正式马来语按语境使用 ikan 或 isi ikan。以下为标准马来语对应搭配。[英语词义来源](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/fish)。

senses.zh_definition: 英语动词：尝试捕捉鱼，尤指钓鱼。
senses.en_definition: To try to catch fish.
senses.ms_definition: Melakukan kegiatan menangkap ikan, khususnya memancing; makna kata kerja bahasa Inggeris fish.
senses.nuances: 马来语对应词须依方式选择：用钓具通常说 memancing，以其他方式捕捞可说 menangkap ikan。以下为马来语对应表达，不表示 fish 已成为标准马来语动词。[英语动词来源](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/fish)。

etymology.historical_story: English fish continues Old English fisc and belongs to a Germanic word family that also includes German Fisch. Its appearance in a Malaysian menu or conversation does not by itself establish a Malay borrowing: speakers may simply be switching languages or retaining an English dish name. Standard Malay uses ikan for the animal and food.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: fish /fɪʃ/ 是英语，ikan 是马来语；看到 fish and chips，就联想到炸鱼薯条。

etymology.historical_story: Italian falcone comes from Latin falco and names a falcon, particularly a larger bird used in falconry. The surname Falcone is associated with that bird name through personal names, nicknames, or an occupation involving falcons. These are possible historical naming routes, not evidence that every person bearing the surname descends from a falconer.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: falcone 的开头与英语 falcon 相近，可联想“隼”；作为姓氏 Falcone 时保留人名，不直接翻译成鸟名。

etymology.historical_story: In medieval Anglo-Norman records, forms including fiz and fitz meant 'son' and appeared in expressions identifying parentage. This historical naming element helps explain familiar Fitz- surnames. It does not establish the identity or origin of this particular corpus token, which still requires its original sentence. [Source: Anglo-Norman Dictionary](https://anglo-norman.net/entry/fitz).

senses.zh_definition: 考虑它、想想这件事；也可按上下文表示想起或惦念所指的人或事。
senses.en_definition: To think about or consider it; contextually, to think about the person or matter referred to.
senses.ms_definition: Mempertimbangkan atau merenungkan perkara yang dirujuk oleh -nya; mengikut konteks, turut membawa maksud mengenangkan orang atau perkara tersebut.
senses.nuances: 常用于祈使句，如 Fikirkannya dahulu。-nya 的指代需要上下文，不能固定理解为“他的”。作为一般主动陈述谓语时通常用 memikirkannya，如 Dia sedang memikirkannya。这里的三语释义是对组合形式的解释，基础义参见 [DBP fikir](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=fikir)。

etymology.historical_story: The ultimate base fikir belongs to Malay's Arabic loan vocabulary and is associated with Arabic fikr, thought. Malay then builds its own grammatical forms around this borrowed base. Fikirkannya combines the Malay suffix -kan with the attached pronoun -nya, illustrating how a borrowed word participates in productive Malay grammar. [Sources: linguistic study](https://plm.org.my/ejurnal/index.php/jurnallinguistik/article/download/249/179/), [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=fikir).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: fikir＝想，fikirkan＝考虑，后接 -nya＝考虑它；整句记：Fikirkannya dahulu——先想一想。

etymology.historical_story: Facebook takes its name from campus face books: directories pairing people's names with photographs. Co-founder Dustin Moskovitz recalled that Harvard residences had separate directories and that the team wanted a unified online version. Facebook launched in 2004, and its name entered Malay as a brand name rather than a translated common noun. See [Moskovitz's recollection](https://www.wired.com/story/sex-beer-and-coding-inside-facebooks-wild-early-days/) and [Meta's timeline](https://www.meta.com/en-gb/about/company-info/).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: face 是脸，book 是册：先想“人脸名册”，再连到分享近况、联系朋友的 Facebook；这只是英语来源助记。

etymology.historical_story: English film names both photographic material and a motion picture, connecting the recording medium with the work recorded on it. Malaysian Malay uses the adapted spelling filem, while Indonesian uses film. An isolated occurrence of film in Malay-language material may therefore reflect English mixing or Indonesian influence; the spelling alone cannot establish its particular route into a text.

etymology.historical_story: English from continues Old English fram, which expressed departure and movement away. Its history belongs to the Germanic languages, rather than to Malay word formation. The familiar modern word connects physical departure with more abstract starting points, including time and source. Its appearance in a Malay text alone does not establish borrowing. [Source: Etymonline](https://www.etymonline.com/word/from)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读到 from，就想象箭头从起点向外伸出：先找“从哪里、从何时、来自谁”，再选择合适的马来语表达。

etymology.historical_story: 这一词族的基础 fikir 来自阿拉伯语 fikr，意思与思考、思想有关；进入马来语后，它参与了本土的词缀构词。[马来亚大学：阿拉伯语借词的形态研究](https://mjs.um.edu.my/index.php/JUD/article/download/7374/5009/15771) 加上 -an 形成名词 fikiran，再接 -nya，便把“心智、思绪”明确归属于语境中的某个人。
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 分两步记忆：fikir → fikiran，把“思考”变成“心智、思绪”；再贴上 -nya 这张所属标签，就成为“他／她的心思”。

etymology.historical_story: English fine has historically distinct adjective and penalty pathways through French, ultimately connected with Latin finis, meaning an end or boundary. The adjective relates to finishing or refinement; the monetary sense developed through payments that settled a dispute. Their shared spelling therefore hides different histories, which also explains why Malay requires different translations. [Oxford：形容词词源](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/fine_1), [Oxford：罚款义词源](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/fine_4)

senses.zh_definition: 频次；某种现象、事件或行为在一定时间或观察范围内重复出现的次数或频繁程度。
senses.en_definition: The number of times, or how often, an event or phenomenon occurs within a specified period or set of observations.
senses.ms_definition: Perihal berulang-ulang sesuatu gejala atau kejadian; kekerapan.
senses.nuances: 本义项侧重一般或统计意义上的出现频次，常见于研究、报告及语料分析。统计频数须交代观察范围，不能直接当作百分比；日常交流常用更通俗的 kekerapan。物理学中以赫兹表示的频率属于该词的专门用法。[DBP 释义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=206468&keyword=frekuensi)

etymology.historical_story: frekuensi 属于马来语吸收的国际术语，与英语 frequency 对应；DBP 的借词拼写规则也用它示范 fr- 辅音组合。[DBP 术语构成指南](https://eseminar.dbp.gov.my/dokumen/umum_istilah.pdf) 英语 frequency 可追溯至拉丁语 frequentia，早期带有聚集、众多的意味，后来用于事物反复出现的频繁程度，再发展出物理学中的重复速率义。[Frequency 词源](https://www.etymonline.com/word/frequency)

etymology.historical_story: English fall descends from Old English feallan, a verb describing downward movement. The same physical image developed into meanings involving declining values and cascading water. Falls survives prominently in geographical names, so a Malay text may contain it simply by retaining an English place name. [Source: Etymonline](https://www.etymonline.com/word/fall)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 看见 Falls 地名，想象水往下 fall，便联想到 air terjun；句子中的 falls 则先检查它是名词复数还是英语动词。

etymology.historical_story: forensik 对应英语 forensic，其历史词源可追至拉丁语 forensis“属于公共议事场所或法庭的”，与 forum 相联系；古罗马的公共场所也是公开讨论和处理争议的空间。[美国国家医学图书馆](https://www.nlm.nih.gov/exhibition/visibleproofs/exhibition/index.html) 这个词后来与为司法程序提供证据的专业检验紧密相连，在马来语中也用于法医学及其他司法鉴证领域。

etymology.historical_story: Flint is an inherited English word, recorded in Old English and related to Middle Dutch vlint and Old High German flins. The material links the word with stone tools and spark-making. Modern English also uses flint for the small spark-producing component in a lighter, even when that component is made from metal rather than natural stone. [Oxford Learner’s Dictionaries](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/definition/english/flint)

etymology.historical_story: fizik 属于与英语 physics 对应的国际科学术语，其远源与希腊语 physis（自然）有关。这个词源家族让人联想到从观察落物、光和声音出发的自然研究；随着学科分化，现代物理学逐渐专门研究物质、能量及其基本规律。[物理学名称与学科演变](https://openbooks.lib.msu.edu/collegephysics/chapter/physics-an-introduction/)

etymology.historical_story: Mary Shelley’s Frankenstein first appeared anonymously in 1818. Its title points to Victor Frankenstein, the creator, yet popular usage also applies his name to the creature. That shift helps explain why the name can evoke both scientific ambition and a creation that escapes its maker’s control. [Oxford introduction](https://english.web.ox.ac.uk/node/1278201), [Collins Dictionary](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/frankenstein).

etymology.historical_story: Felix comes from Latin felix, associated with being fortunate or happy. It became a personal name and was borne by numerous early Christian saints. Its appearance in a Malay sentence therefore need not indicate a Malay vocabulary item: names travel between languages while retaining their identity. The name's historical meaning does not describe every person who bears it. [Name history](https://www.behindthename.com/name/felix)

etymology.historical_story: 词根 faham 借自阿拉伯语 fahm（فَهْم），意为理解、领悟；借入马来语后，读音中出现元音，形成 faham。这个借词进一步接受马来语后缀 -i，构成 fahami，把“理解”用作指向具体内容的动作。[UTM：阿拉伯语借词研究](https://humanities.utm.my/islamic/wp-content/uploads/sites/29/2021/07/Buku-Arab-1-1.pdf)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 想象读完指示后，脑中亮起一盏灯：faham 是“懂了”，fahami arahan 是“把指示弄懂”。

senses.en_definition: A deposit of small ice crystals on a surface; also, weather in which the temperature falls below freezing.
senses.ms_definition: Istilah bahasa Inggeris yang bermaksud lapisan hablur ais halus pada permukaan, atau keadaan cuaca di bawah takat beku; padanan bahasa Melayunya ialah fros.
senses.nuances: 正式马来语写 fros，而不是 frost；后者可出现在英文引文或语言夹用中。以下搭配采用马来语对应词。霜不是降落的雪，也不是液态露水。[DBP：fros 与 frost](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=fros)

etymology.historical_story: The English weather word frost has a Malay counterpart, fros, recorded by DBP. Its spelling illustrates how a borrowed technical word can take a different written form in Malay. The concept is useful in geography, agriculture, and accounts of cold climates: the white coating on a surface is ice, unlike liquid dew. [DBP dictionary](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=fros)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 frost 连到“霜”；写马来语时去掉末尾 t，记作 fros。姓氏 Frost 则保留原拼写和大写。

etymology.historical_story: Florida preserves a Spanish colonial place name. In 1513, Juan Ponce de León called the area La Florida in connection with Pascua Florida, Spain's Easter celebration. The name therefore carries a seasonal and floral association, while its use in Malay identifies a place rather than a productive Malay root. [Florida Department of State](https://dos.fl.gov/florida-facts/florida-history/a-brief-history/european-exploration-and-colonization/)

senses.zh_definition: 某项发展、活动或进程中可区分的阶段。
senses.en_definition: A distinct stage in a process, activity, or course of development.
senses.ms_definition: Peringkat atau tahap dalam rangkaian sesuatu perkembangan, kegiatan atau kemajuan.
senses.nuances: 强调进程中的阶段划分，常用于项目、建设、学习及人生发展。fasa pertama 指第一阶段；进入新阶段常说 memasuki fasa baharu。

senses.zh_definition: 物理或化学系统中性质均匀、与其他部分存在可辨界面的相。
senses.en_definition: A physically distinct, homogeneous part of a material system.
senses.ms_definition: Bahagian homogen dalam sesuatu sistem bahan yang mempunyai sifat fizikal seragam dan dapat dibezakan daripada bahagian lain.
senses.nuances: 科技义译为“相”。同一物态中也可能存在多个相，例如互不相溶的两种液体，不能一概把 fasa 等同于“物态”。[DBP 科技术语](https://prpmv1.dbp.gov.my/Search.aspx?k=fasa)

senses.zh_definition: 周期性变化中的相位；电工学中也指多相交流电系统的一相。
senses.en_definition: A position within a periodic cycle; also, one alternating component of a multiphase electrical system.
senses.ms_definition: Kedudukan sesuatu getaran atau gelombang dalam satu kitaran; juga satu komponen arus atau voltan dalam sistem elektrik berbilang fasa.
senses.nuances: 波动语境常译“相位”，供电语境常译“相”。单相与三相说明电力系统的结构，不表示第一阶段与第三阶段。[DBP 科技术语](https://prpmv1.dbp.gov.my/Search.aspx?k=fasa)

senses.zh_definition: 从地球观察到的月球受光部分在运行周期中呈现的形状，即月相。
senses.en_definition: An apparent shape of the Moon's illuminated portion as seen from Earth.

etymology.historical_story: Fasa belongs to the international vocabulary represented by English phase. That word ultimately traces to Greek phasis, associated with celestial appearances and the Moon. The image offers a useful bridge: a changing appearance becomes a recognizable stage. In Malay, the same word connects lunar cycles, scientific systems, and the successive stages of a building project. [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/phase), [DBP](https://prpmv1.dbp.gov.my/Search.aspx?k=fasa)

etymology.historical_story: Flynn is an anglicized form of Irish Ó Floinn, meaning a descendant of Flann, a personal name associated with red or ruddy colouring. Woulfe documented several distinct Irish families bearing this surname. Its ancestral meaning belongs to name history; it does not describe the appearance or ancestry of every modern bearer. [Woulfe, Irish Names and Surnames](https://libraryireland.booksulster.com/names/of/o-floinn.php)

etymology.historical_story: Francis is the English form of the Late Latin name Franciscus, meaning a Frenchman. Its spread through medieval Europe was closely associated with Saint Francis of Assisi, whose Italian name was Francesco. This historical association explains an important naming tradition, but a modern person called Francis need not be French or belong to any particular religion. See [the name history](https://www.behindthename.com/name/francis).

etymology.historical_story: Malay uses f as part of its Roman alphabet, known locally as Rumi. The same letter also serves specialized purposes: uppercase F represents fluorine, while °F identifies Fahrenheit temperatures. These uses show how one written shape can belong to different naming systems. Its interpretation depends on capitalization, accompanying signs, and the subject being discussed.

etymology.historical_story: Fischer is a German occupational surname associated with fishing. Its source word names a person who catches fish, preserving an occupation in a family name. In Malay discourse, however, Fischer identifies a person or family rather than their profession. The surname alone does not establish the bearer’s present occupation, nationality, religion, or relationship to another Fischer. [Reference](https://de.wiktionary.org/wiki/Fischer)

etymology.historical_story: Fasal is an Arabic borrowing associated with a division or section of a text. In Malay, its meanings extend from textual clauses to matters under discussion and expressions introducing topics or reasons. Malaysian usage preserves fasal in legal terminology, while pasal is recognized as its conversational variant. This pairing connects formal document language with everyday speech. Sources: [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=fasal), [Parliament glossary](https://www.parlimen.gov.my/index.php?action=20000&id=19&lang=bm&modload=glosari).

word_family.gloss: 有所预感；依据征兆推测

senses.zh_definition: 相术；传统上根据面貌、身体等外在征象推断人的性情或命运的知识。
senses.en_definition: The traditional art of inferring character or fortune from facial or bodily features.
senses.ms_definition: Pengetahuan tradisional untuk mentafsir perangai atau nasib seseorang melalui ciri wajah dan tubuhnya.
senses.nuances: 常见于 ilmu firasat，属于传统文化及文学语境；释义描述的是一种传统观念，并不把相貌判断视为科学事实。义项依据 [DBP：firasat](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=113780&keyword=firasat)。

senses.zh_definition: 观察到某些迹象后，对尚未发生的事情产生的直觉或预感。
senses.en_definition: An intuitive feeling about a future event, prompted by perceived signs.
senses.ms_definition: Gerak hati tentang sesuatu yang bakal berlaku berdasarkan petanda yang diperhatikan.
senses.nuances: 这是日常交谈中最实用的义项。可以是好预感，也可以是不祥之感；firasat 本身不限定结果好坏。它表达个人感受，不等于已经证实的判断。

senses.zh_definition: 传统观念中被认为可以显示一个人性情的面部或身体征象。
senses.en_definition: Facial or bodily signs traditionally interpreted as indications of a person's character.
senses.ms_definition: Petanda pada wajah atau tubuh yang dianggap mencerminkan perangai seseorang.
senses.nuances: 此义指被解读的征象本身，区别于义项一的知识体系；主要见于传统叙述和文学用法。相关搭配偏书面，不宜当作现代科学判断术语。

etymology.historical_story: Firasat comes from Arabic firāsah, associated with perceptive discernment. Malay usage embraces both traditional interpretation of bodily signs and the everyday feeling that something may happen. The Jawi spelling فراسة preserves the word's Arabic visual heritage. Its cultural history connects observation, interpretation, and intuition rather than a single notion of fortune-telling. See this [University of Malaya journal study](https://ijie.um.edu.my/index.php/MUQADDIMAH/article/download/62554/18598/174172).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 看见一点迹象，心里先有感觉：firasat 是事情发生前冒出的预感；加 ilmu，便想到传统观相知识。

etymology.historical_story: Freddy belongs to a group of familiar personal names associated with Frederick and other related names. Freddie is another established spelling, while Fred is a shorter related form. These relationships belong to naming traditions rather than Malay affixation. A particular bearer may use Freddy independently, so the spelling does not establish that person's full name.

senses.zh_definition: 〔马英混合口语〕感觉、氛围或情绪感染力，尤指音乐、表演或场景带来的情绪体验。
senses.en_definition: In informal Malay-English speech, an emotional quality, atmosphere, or expressive feeling.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam percakapan campur bahasa, rasa, suasana atau penghayatan emosi yang ditimbulkan oleh sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 如 ada feel 可表示“有感觉、能打动人”。正式表达按语境选 perasaan、suasana、penghayatan 或 kesan emosi。本条为口语用法概括，并非 DBP 官方词条定义；标准 berasa 的释义可参见 [DBP：berasa](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=berasa)。

senses.zh_definition: 〔马英混合口语〕感到、觉得或体会到某种情绪、状态或印象。
senses.en_definition: In informal Malay-English speech, to experience a feeling or have a particular impression.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam percakapan campur bahasa, mengalami sesuatu perasaan atau mendapat sesuatu tanggapan.
senses.nuances: 用于临时语码混合，不必套用英语时态变化，也不能因此视为标准马来语动词。正式表达通常改用 berasa 或 merasakan；涉及身体触摸时则须另按语境翻译，不将所有英语 feel 的义项自动搬入本条。

etymology.historical_story: Feel retains its English spelling when speakers insert it into a Malay conversation. Its emotional use can describe either an experience or the atmosphere of music and performance. This entry treats those uses as informal language mixing rather than established standard Malay vocabulary. The packet supplies no evidence identifying when these particular Malaysian uses first appeared.

senses.zh_definition: 不受现实限制的想象活动；幻想或遐想。
senses.en_definition: Imagination unrestricted by reality; fantasy or fanciful thought.

senses.ms_definition: Ciptaan imaginasi yang tidak terbatas, sama ada dinyatakan atau semata-mata dibayangkan.
senses.nuances: 侧重想象的产物，而第一义侧重想象活动。用于小说、电影等时，常指奇幻类型，不表示作品质量低劣。

senses.zh_definition: 仅作装饰、不发挥通常实用功能的物品或部件。

senses.ms_definition: Barang atau bahagian pakaian yang diadakan sebagai hiasan tanpa fungsi lazimnya.
senses.nuances: 服饰语境中的较少见义项，通常置于名词后作限定；saku fantasi 指装饰口袋，不能按正常口袋使用。

senses.zh_definition: 形式自由、具有即兴想象色彩的器乐作品；幻想曲。
senses.en_definition: An instrumental composition of free form and an imaginative or improvisatory character; a fantasia.
senses.ms_definition: Gubahan instrumental berbentuk bebas yang menonjolkan imaginasi serta sifat improvisasi.
senses.nuances: 音乐专业义；不能把所有富于想象力的音乐都直接归类为 fantasi。[DBP 音乐术语](https://prpmv1.dbp.gov.my/Search.aspx?k=fantasi)

etymology.historical_story: Fantasi belongs to an international vocabulary of imagination. Its English counterpart, fantasy, ultimately traces through Latin to Greek phantasia, associated with appearance and mental imagery. This shared history helps connect an imagined scene with a finished imaginative work; it does not by itself establish the immediate donor language of the Malay form. [Dictionary.com](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/fantasy)

etymology.historical_story: Fikir belongs to Malay's Arabic-derived vocabulary of thought, reflecting Arabic fikr, meaning thought or reflection. Malay combines the borrowed base with its own grammatical resources: -kan directs thinking toward an object, and -lah adds an exhortative tone here. Fikirkanlah therefore illustrates how an established loan participates fully in Malay sentence formation. [Historical Malay dictionary](https://ms.wikisource.org/wiki/Malay-English_Vocabulary/F)

etymology.historical_story: English fort came through French from Latin fortis, meaning strong. The history links physical strength with a place built to resist attack. In Malaysia, the English form remains visible in heritage names such as Fort Cornwallis, while Malay descriptions commonly use kubu or kota. A familiar landmark therefore helps learners distinguish a retained foreign name from an ordinary Malay noun. [Etymology](https://www.ahdictionary.com/word/search.html?q=fort), [heritage name](https://www.mypenang.gov.my/view_directory.php?id=Q3Z3ZG1Sa2o1dGJDc3VtTWo2dlNpdz09).

etymology.historical_story: Fateh illustrates how a name can cross languages without preserving every distinction in its original script. Related naming traditions draw on Arabic words connected with opening and victory, but the Latin spelling alone cannot identify the exact source form. The historical lesson is practical: establish the person's original spelling and pronunciation before assigning a precise etymological meaning. [Related name forms](https://www.behindthename.com/name/fateh/tree)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先把 Fateh 当作姓名整体记忆；读音向本人确认，词义再由原文拼写核实，不靠谐音猜来源。

etymology.historical_story: English first descends through Middle English from Old English fyrst, with related forms in other Germanic languages. Its long history belongs to English, rather than Malay word formation. In a mixed Malay sentence, the whole English word can express an order or priority for which standard Malay uses pertama or dahulu. [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/first)

etymology.historical_story: Fasiliti is an adaptation of English facility. Its institutional setting is visible in Malaysian terminology: CIDB defines facilities through buildings, infrastructure, and related amenities serving users. DBP language advice has preferred kemudahan. Together, these sources show a distinction between an established administrative term and a broadly accessible Malay equivalent. [CIDB](https://www.cidb.gov.my/wp-content/uploads/2022/10/Pendaftaran-Kontraktor-Fasiliti.pdf), [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=fasiliti).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把英语 facility 的外形改读成四拍 fa-si-li-ti，脑中依次出现球场、浴室、储物柜：都是提供使用便利的设施。

etymology.historical_story: Football is transparently an English compound of foot and ball. For this lexicon, its important cultural distinction is between an English expression and its Malay equivalent: DBP translates the game as bola sepak and the object as bola. Retaining football in a Malay conversation illustrates language mixing; it does not establish an official Malay headword. [DBP entry](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=football).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: foot 是脚，ball 是球：脚加球联想到足球；转成标准马来语时记住 bola sepak。

morphology.pattern_note: 按输入词项作为英语整词处理，无马来语词缀。英语内部为 fly + -ing → flying；-ing 不是马来语后缀。读音采用标准英语，见 [Cambridge 发音词典](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/pronunciation/english/flying)。

word_family.gloss: 英语派生词：飞行者；飞行员

senses.zh_definition: 会飞的；飞行中的。英语词项，规范马来语通常用 terbang 或 yang terbang 表达。
senses.en_definition: Able to fly, or moving through the air.
senses.ms_definition: Kata bahasa Inggeris yang menerangkan sesuatu yang boleh terbang atau sedang bergerak di udara; padanannya ialah terbang atau yang terbang.
senses.nuances: 属于英语及马英混用语境。下列搭配保留英语形式；其马来语对应分别为 serangga terbang 和 ikan terbang。DBP 将 flying 列于英语词典栏目，不能据此认定它是规范马来语形容词。见 [DBP 英马词典](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=336480&keyword=flying)。

senses.zh_definition: 驾驶航空器的活动；飞行操作。
senses.en_definition: The activity of piloting an aircraft.
senses.ms_definition: Kegiatan mengendalikan pesawat udara; dalam bahasa Melayu, lazimnya dinyatakan sebagai penerbangan atau kegiatan menerbangkan pesawat.
senses.nuances: 指驾驶或操纵飞机，区别于作为乘客搭机。英语搭配 flying school 和 flying lessons 的规范马来语对应为 sekolah penerbangan 和 pelajaran menerbangkan pesawat。见 [DBP 英马词典](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=336480&keyword=flying)。

senses.zh_definition: 乘飞机旅行；航空出行。
senses.en_definition: Travel by aircraft.
senses.ms_definition: Perjalanan dengan menaiki pesawat udara; padanannya ialah perjalanan udara atau penerbangan, mengikut konteks.
senses.nuances: 马英混用口语中的 saya flying esok 通常表示“我明天搭飞机”，并不表示本人驾驶飞机；这里借用了英语动词形式。下列英语搭配对应 takut menaiki kapal terbang 和 masa penerbangan。见 [DBP 英马词典](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=336480&keyword=flying)。

etymology.historical_story: Flying belongs to the English family of fly, with the ending -ing marking an activity or participial form. etymology.historical_story: Festival belongs to an international word family whose European history leads back to Latin vocabulary for feasts and holidays. etymology.historical_story: The base fikir belongs to Malay's Arabic-derived vocabulary of thought and reflection. Malay then combines it with its own particle -lah. The result illustrates how borrowed vocabulary becomes part of everyday Malay grammar: a word associated with thinking can become a gentle invitation, firm instruction, or impatient rebuke through a small particle and a change of tone.

etymology.historical_story: Fletcher entered Middle English from Anglo-French flecher, associated with fleche, meaning an arrow. Merriam-Webster dates its recorded English use to the fourteenth century. Like Baker and Carpenter, an occupational label also became a surname. Modern readers may therefore encounter Fletcher as a person's name without any implication that the person actually makes arrows. etymology.historical_story: Franklin began as an English social designation for a free landholder rather than a nobleman. The designation became a surname and later also a given name. Its earlier forms include Middle English frankeleyn and Anglo-Norman fraunclein. This explains the name's historical background, but does not identify which Franklin the supplied lowercase token denotes. [Surname dictionary](https://www.ancestry.co.uk/last-name-meaning/franklin)

etymology.historical_story: English five descends from Old English fif and belongs to an inherited Germanic number family, with relatives such as Dutch vijf and German fünf. etymology.historical_story: Firma belongs to a European commercial word family associated with business names and signatures. The related English noun firm ultimately connects with Italian firma, meaning signature: the name signed on commercial documents came to represent the business itself. This explains the wider word family, although it does not establish the exact borrowing route into Malay. [Historical discussion](https://www.jbs.cam.ac.uk/wp-content/uploads/2023/05/cbrwp531.pdf)

etymology.historical_story: Faedah comes from Arabic fāʾida, meaning benefit or advantage. In Malay, the same word can describe what a person gains from education and what a lender receives on a loan. That pairing offers a useful cultural and semantic bridge: an everyday idea of usefulness also serves as a precise financial term. [Etymological reference](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/faedah).

etymology.historical_story: Malay fesyen adapts English fashion into Malay spelling. The English word came through French from a Latin expression associated with making or shaping. That history connects creating a form with adopting a popular style. Malay also builds its own derivatives, including berfesyen and memfesyenkan, around the borrowed base. English history: [Dictionary.com: fashion](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/fashion).

etymology.historical_story: Fakta belongs to an international vocabulary of evidence. Its ultimate Latin source, facta, is the plural of factum, a thing done. Malay uses fakta without requiring a plural interpretation. Adding the Malay element -nya connects this international word to a particular discussion, article, or situation, making an abstract fact something contextually identifiable. [Research on Malay vocabulary](https://oarep.usim.edu.my/server/api/core/bitstreams/14c33fe2-86a8-45d2-9755-b68c2367e024/content)

etymology.historical_story: Fucked is an English inflection of fuck, a sexual verb with a long written history and an uncertain deeper origin. Its taboo force supports figurative meanings involving disaster, damage, and exhaustion. The ending -ed contributes grammatical form, while context determines whether the meaning is sexual or figurative. [Word history](https://www.etymonline.com/word/fuck)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记住fuck + -ed，词尾读/t/；先判断“发生过的动作”还是“糟透了的状态”，再根据对象确定意思。

morphology.pattern_note: 英语借用形式，作为整词记忆，不按马来语词缀拆分。/fi.nal/ 为按马来语拼读的读法；英语语码转换时也可读 /ˈfaɪ.nəl/。资料包未提供音节划分与爪夷文，相关字段保留 null。下列词族成员为复合表达，并非词缀派生词。

word_family.gloss: 半决赛；正式马来语通常用 separuh akhir

senses.zh_definition: 决赛；决定冠军或最终名次的最后一场比赛或最后阶段。
senses.en_definition: The deciding match or concluding stage of a competition.
senses.ms_definition: Perlawanan atau peringkat akhir sesuatu pertandingan.
senses.nuances: 常见于体育交流和英语夹用。正式马来语通常用 perlawanan akhir 或 peringkat akhir。此处马来语释义根据 DBP 英马词典的对应义编写，不冒称独立马来语词条的官方原文；status 按指定输出格式填写，不表示 DBP 对所有夹用形式的认可。[DBP：final](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=115704&keyword=final)

senses.zh_definition: 期末考试；课程或学期结束时举行的考试。
senses.en_definition: An examination held at the end of a course or semester.
senses.ms_definition: Peperiksaan pada akhir sesuatu kursus atau semester.
senses.nuances: 主要是学生之间的英语夹用；正式通知用 peperiksaan akhir 或 peperiksaan akhir semester。[DBP：final](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=115704&keyword=final)

senses.zh_definition: 最后阶段的；表示版本、准备工作或程序已到最后一轮。
senses.en_definition: Coming at the end of a sequence or process.
senses.ms_definition: Yang terakhir dalam sesuatu urutan atau proses.
senses.nuances: 常见于职场夹用，如 draf final；正式文件宜用 draf akhir、versi akhir 等。表示顺序上的最后，不一定表示法律上不可更改。[DBP：final](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=115704&keyword=final)

senses.zh_definition: 已作最后决定的；不再更改或讨论的。
senses.en_definition: Settled and no longer open to alteration or discussion.
senses.ms_definition: Muktamad dan tidak akan diubah lagi.
senses.nuances: 强调决定已经确定。正式马来语优先用 muktamad；直接对人说 Ini final 可能显得强硬。[DBP：final](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=115704&keyword=final)

etymology.historical_story: Final belongs to the English vocabulary used in Malaysian conversation about sport, examinations and work. Its English history runs through French and Latin finalis, ultimately connected with finis, meaning a boundary or end. That endpoint image connects a championship's deciding match with a document's last version. [Merriam-Webster: final](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/final)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 final 和熟悉的英语 final 连起来：比赛走到终点是决赛，文件走到终点是最终版。

senses.zh_definition: 黎明；天将亮而太阳尚未升起的时段。

senses.ms_definition: Dinihari; subuh.

senses.zh_definition: 曙光；日出前东方天空出现的微红亮光。

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 涉及晨礼或斋戒时，应尊重 fajar sidik 的专门含义。普通的“天亮前出发”无需赋予宗教含义；讨论具体礼拜时间宜采用当地公布的 waktu Subuh。

etymology.historical_story: Fajar is borrowed from Arabic fajr, meaning dawn. Malay gives the word two syllables, fa.jar, while its Jawi spelling preserves the Arabic letter sequence. The word belongs to both descriptions of the morning sky and religious vocabulary: fajar sidik names true dawn, linking an everyday natural event with the timing of worship. [Etymology](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/fajar), [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=fajar)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fa.jar 想成“发亮”：东方开始发亮，就是 fajar。此为记忆联想，并非汉语词源。
